issues.title: Formal statistical validity is not established
issues.evidence: configs/statistical_plan.json declares frozen 12/72 task strata and five repeats per arm, but src/scientific_discovery/cli.py only provides a one-run pilot path, accepts arbitrary manifests and limits, has no formal command, and does not execute repeat loops or assign replicate indices. Analysis also operates only on result files and does not join the registered manifest to synthesize missing task-runs; repeated rows lack persisted replicate identity.
issues.remediation: Implement plan-driven pilot/formal execution with exact task counts, frozen manifest SHA-256, five registered replicates per arm, explicit persisted replicate_index, rejection of deviations, and analysis against the frozen manifest multiplied by repeats and arms. Add adversarial tests for unequal/incomplete clusters, failures, repeats, missing files, domain strata and complexity strata.

history.reason: These are partial engineering changes, not evidence of formal statistical validity: runtime repeat/stratum enforcement, replicate matching, complete registered denominators, and formal execution remain unverified.
